trigger: Interact with Marguerite on her porch.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Adele, my dear. You are still upright. Good. Come.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Mr. Pruitt, three doors down. His oxygen machine needs a wall plug.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: His spare tanks are gone tonight. After that he breathes on his own. He cannot.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: You have a gas can in your car. Ray has a generator he won't lend. You understand?

choices.text: Ask Ray. I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: With the machine, months. Without it, perhaps Thursday.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: I am not asking you to choose, my dear. I am telling you there is a choice.

choices.text: Ask Ray. I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Thank you. He will complain about the noise. That is how you know he's alive.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Bring Theo by. I have a thermometer and opinions.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No fuel now. The cooler will have to do, or Ray.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: Of course. Theo first. I would do the same.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: I would also hate it. Go on.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Marguerite goes back inside. She does not close the door all the way.

nodes.speaker: marguerite
nodes.text: I asked. He said 'yah, no.' Try. He likes you more than me.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Ray's garage is across the alley. You can hear the generator.
